runtime: WSL Ubuntu 22.04, PHP 8.4.23 CLI server, 4 workers plus parent, OPcache enabled, timestamp validation disabled, Xdebug disabled, private temporary copy on Linux filesystem
cache: Redis 7, isolated cache DB 6, 30-second menu cache, warmup
load: 100 order iterations shared by 5 VUs, each checkout replayed; 2 kitchen polling sessions for 20 seconds; 100 menu warmup requests
limits: Checkout per-IP rate intentionally raised to 20000 for single-source benchmark. Database queues, outbound broadcasting disabled. No production server, real Reverb latency, large menus, sustained soak or 100 concurrent kitchens measured.
